survey_contract.observer_gap: Existing V2Quiet requires 60 seconds with a fresh clear-since value, longer than the <=30-second live-noise receipt. Consumer logs OBSERVER_QUIET_CONTRACT_REFUSED and releases through existing ledger. No distance/grace reduction or TTL extension is authorized here; #135 must supply a verified physical cohort/observer interface before useful noise traversal can be accepted.
survey_contract.recovery: Routes are transient. Restart does not resume a JSON route or restore a pack. Exact native identity reconciliation remains unchanged; unresolved reservations never spawn replacements. A new lifecycle needs new observed evidence and an existing admitted physical pack.
